recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a single-file browser-native mobile portrait platformer called **Capkin Quest: Star Sprout Road**. It should satisfy this prompt: a Mario platformer game with bright mushroom-kingdom energy, precise jumping, momentum-based movement, whimsical enemies, secret blocks, power-ups, cheerful adventure, and family-friendly arcade challenge with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range

The source truth is a tile-based side-view platformer with momentum movement, jump physics, solid blocks, hazard tiles, goal tiles, a start tile, story levels, mobile left/right/jump controls, keyboard controls, a level editor, and base64 course import/export. Preserve those mechanics exactly. Rebuild the presentation as a bright mushroom-road arcade adventure: Capkin is a small cap-wearing hero, solid tiles are secret question bricks, hazards are whimsical chomper critters, the goal is a Star Sprout Gate, and success is a cheerful parade. Use canvas/CSS procedural art, readable touch controls, and compact portrait-first UI.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: side-view tile platformer with a lightweight course editor and story level selector
- objective: guide the avatar from a start tile to a star goal tile while avoiding enemy hazard tiles
- input model: keyboard arrows/WASD/space plus mobile left/right/jump touch buttons; editor uses pointer placement and palette selection
- core loop: choose or build a course, spawn at the start tile, accelerate with momentum, jump under gravity, collide with solid tiles, avoid hazards, reach the goal, then return to map/editor/menu
- fail/friction state: touching a hazard or falling below the world triggers death particles/audio and resets the player after a short delay; winning opens a modal and freezes player motion

## Protected mechanics
- Horizontal acceleration, friction, velocity clamping, gravity, and jump impulse remain equivalent to the source.
- Tile size, tile IDs, base64 JSON course format, editor placement/removal, start tile, solid tile, hazard tile, and goal tile semantics are preserved.
- Collision resolution remains axis-separated rectangle/tile collision with solid blocks, hazard overlap death, and goal contact win.
- Mobile controls, keyboard controls, menu/map/editor/test/import/export flows, reset after death, and win modal flow are preserved.

## Remixed target
Capkin Quest: Star Sprout Road reframes the same platformer as a bright mushroom-road adventure: the focal Capkin hero makes precise momentum jumps across secret question bricks, avoids giggling chomper critters, and reaches the Star Sprout Gate. Presentation, HUD language, background motifs, fonts, particles, and mobile portrait hierarchy are transformed while the mechanic truth is protected.
